lines: DA KINGDOM NEEDS A STRONG RULER. DEMOCRACY IZ CHAOS!
ONE PERSON NO SHOULD HAB ALL DAT POWER. PEOPLE DESERVE A VOICE!
DA MASSES IZ EASILY SWAYED. DEY NEED GUIDANCE!
DAT IZ EXACTLY WHAT TYRANTS SAY TA JUSTIFY OPPRESSION!

CHANGE FROM WITHIN IZ SAFER. REVOLUTION BRINGS BLOODSHED!
SOMETIMES BLOOD IZ DA PRICE OF FREEDOM!
SPOKEN LIKE SOMEONE WHO IZ NEVER SEEN WAR...
WHY SHOULD NOBLES LIVE IN LUXURY WHILE PEASANTS STARVE?

AN' CARRY DA BURDEN OF RESPONSIBILITY FROM BIRTH!

ME BELIEVE PEOPLE IZ INHERENTLY GOOD!

ME HAB SEEN TOO MUCH TA BELIEVE DAT FAIRY TALE!
WHAT IZ DA POINT OF ALL DIS? WHY DO WE STRUGGLE?
TA GROW, TA LOVE, TA LEAVE DA WORLD BETTER!
BUT WE ALL DIE. EVERYTINK WE DO TURNS TA DUST!
DA JOURNEY MATTERS MORE DEN DA DESTINATION!

BUT WHO DECIDES WHAT DA 'GREATER GOOD' IZ?
DOZE WIT DA COURAGE TA ACT WHEN OTHERS NO WILL!
SHOULD WE ALWAYS PUT DUTY BEFORE PERSONAL HAPPINESS?

BUT A LIFE WITOUT JOY IZ NO LIFE AT ALL!
JOY COMES FROM FULFILLIN' ONE'S PURPOSE!
IZ IT BETTER TA LIVE SAFELY OR TA LIVE FULLY?

BUT PEOPLE GET HURT CHASIN' FULLNESS!
DEY GET HURT EITHER WAY. AT LEAST ONE VERSION HAB A GOOD STORY!

DEN WHO PROTECTS PEOPLE FROM DA LAW ITSELF?

TELL DAT TA SOMEONE BORN WIT NUTTIN', IN DA WRONG TOWN!
PLENTY OF PEOPLE RISE FROM NUTTIN'!
AN' MANY MORE DO NO. DAT IZ DA POINT!

A LIL' AUDIENCE IZ STILL AN AUDIENCE!
SOMETIMES IT IZ DA ONLY ONE DAT COUNTS!
IZ IT EVER RIGHT TA LIE TA PROTECT SOMEONE FROM DA TRUTH?
YES. SOMETIMES DA TRUTH DOES MORE HARM DEN GOOD!
BUT WHO DECIDES WHAT HARM LOOKS LIKE? DA LIAR?
SOMEONE HAB TA. DA TRUTH IZ NO ALWAYS KIND!
KINDNESS BUILT ON LIES HAB ANOTHER NAME: CONTROL!
ANIMALS SHOULD HAB DA SAME RIGHTS AS PEOPLE!
RIGHTS REQUIRE RESPONSIBILITIES. ANIMALS NO CAN HOLD DEM!
NEITHER CAN INFANTS, AN' WE PROTECT DEM!
INFANTS GROW INTO RESPONSIBILITY. DAT IZ A DIFFERENT CASE!
IZ IT? WE DRAW DA LINE WHERE IT IZ CONVENIENT!

NO. EVEN DA PEOPLE CLOSEST TA US IZ PARTLY STRANGERS!
DAT SOUNDS BLEAK.
ME TINK IT IZ BEAUTIFUL. DERE IZ ALWAYS MORE TA DISCOVER!
ART AN' MUSIC IZ LUXURIES. IN HARD TIMES, WE SHOULD FOCUS ON SURVIVAL!

YOU NO CAN EAT A PAINTIN'!

KNOWIN' DA END WOULD MAKE EVERY DAY FEEL INTENTIONAL!
OR PARALYZED. YOU IZ ASSUMIN' YOU WOULD BE BRAVE 'BOUT IT!
